_judgments.DD_fields: Documented limitation, no DD change required for the PSL to close. Bank name, masked account and payment method are payment-instruction data of the pay run, not country master data. Employer operating name and mailing address are legal-entity configuration ($legal_entity.*), not employee DD fields. The Spec rows state 'No DD master-data field', which is accurate. Correction to the ruling as stated: the DD does have employer physical-address fields (Country Fields 'Employer address delivery line', 'city', 'State', 'ZIP code', ...), and Spec E16 maps to them. Only the mailing address (if different) and the operating name have no DD field. Carry both to the DESIGN stage as legal-entity setup items (MN 181.032(b)); not a PSL finding.
